description.value:
You come from Lorwyn, a land of endless sunshine, or you have studied it intensely. You see the majestic Eirdu as the living embodiment of the sun, and you love setting off on whimsical adventures. You hold your loved ones close, at least in your heart, for you have seen some of them wander into Shadowmoor or beyond and return as faded versions of themselves. Even so, you are brave and always eager for new experiences.

Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.uvpGYCOBFl2noAjA]{Child of the Sun}

Skill Proficiencies: Athletics and Nature

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Quarterstaff}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Backpack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBasket00000]{Basket}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment} (4 sheets), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRope0000000]{Rope}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP
